主要内容: DISH Network Corporation, through its wholly-owned subsidiary DISH DBS Corporation, priced $1.1 billion in 7-year, 5.125% Senior Notes due 2020 and $1.2 billion in 5-year, 4.250% Senior Notes due 2018. The 2020 Notes mature on May 1, 2020, with interest paid semi-annually starting November 1, 2013. The 2018 Notes mature on April 1, 2018, with interest paid semi-annually starting October 1, 2013. The total offering amounted to $2.3 billion, with proceeds intended for general corporate purposes, including wireless and spectrum-related transactions. The notes were issued in private placements under Rule 144A and Regulation S, without registration under the Securities Act or other jurisdictions. The offering was announced on April 3, 2013.
